name: LedgeClimbController
src_typeComment: A simplified raycast ledge-climb: detect -> snap to a hang position -> trigger a climb-up. Architected as the SCAFFOLDING for a full Assassin's-Creed-style traversal system, not the finished thing — per spec, the actual climb motion is a plain position lerp (no animation set exists yet), but every moment an animation system would care about (ledge found/lost, grabbed, climb started/progressing/finished) fires as a UnityEvent, so swapping the lerp for a root-motion animation later only means unsubscribing this component's own movement and hooking real clips onto the SAME events instead — nothing about the detection or the public API needs to change.  Pairs with the existing Toolkit/Controller/KinematicCharacterController, which this DISABLES while hanging/climbing so the two don't fight over the CharacterController — but works standalone too (that reference is optional).

src_serialized.name: ledgeMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Which colliders count as climbable ledges.

src_serialized.name: wallCheckHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: Height above the character's feet the forward wall-check ray is cast from — roughly chest/hand height.

src_serialized.name: ledgeSearchHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: How far above the wall-hit point to start searching downward for the ledge's top surface.

src_serialized.name: minLedgeHeightAboveFeet
src_serialized.tooltip: A ledge whose top is below this height above the feet is treated as just a step, not something worth climbing.

src_serialized.name: maxLedgeHeightAboveFeet
src_serialized.tooltip: A ledge whose top is above this height above the feet is out of reach.

src_serialized.name: standInset
src_serialized.tooltip: How far past the ledge edge the character ends up standing after climbing, so they land clearly ON the platform rather than teetering right at its lip.

TryDetectLedge
src_members.comment: Public (not just driven from Update()) so a self-test — or a character that wants detection only on demand rather than every frame — can call it directly.

src_members.name: Grab
src_members.comment: Snaps directly to the hang position found by the last successful TryDetectLedge(). Call this from whatever input action should trigger a grab (e.g. Jump while a ledge is detected and airborne).

src_members.name: ClimbUp
src_members.comment: Starts the climb-up. Call from whatever input action should trigger it while hanging (e.g. Jump again, or a dedicated Climb action).
